text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having finished the summer training camp to build ability,
Gold City...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Somehow, whenever you're brimming with confidence, it just feels super suspicious.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Seriously.
...Still, I can feel it too.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I think I'm starting to look forward to the Kikuka Sho.
I'm sure... No, never mind.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I'll definitely make you say the words I want to hear!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Tama!
How long are ya gonna keep running?!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
If you don't get ready quick,
the bus is gonna leave, you know?!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hey,
are you listening to me?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
This is it!
I've finally found it—my path to victory...!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"I'm gonna show everyone who looked down on me!
The real me starts right now...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so... the summer training camp, swirling with all kinds of emotions,
came to an end.
